name: StiltAlderTall
collider: trunk + stilt roots solid (capsules per root/trunk segment or simplified mesh of the Bark/BarkMossy objects); branches above head height and crown cards (Plants) no collider. Open gaps under the roots stay passable only if the scene wants it (clearance under the junction ~1.9 m).
notes: Pivot = centre of the root feet at the bottom of the feet (feet go 0.40 m under the water line). Objects: Bark (trunk top, branches, twigs), BarkMossy (lower trunk + stilt roots), Moss (drape on upward faces), Plants (layered alder_clump_0/1 crown cards, 8 tris each). Wind UV2: bark sway up to ~0.05 m, crown cards sway up to ~0.13 m + flutter 0.035 m.
